ja.L: 別のたとえを聞きなさい。
ja.B: もう一つのたとえを聞きなさい。
ja.R: もう一つ、たとえを聞きなさい。

decisions.choice: parable: a story that compares and teaches
decisions.reason: As in chapter 13, a parable sets a picture beside the truth it teaches.

decisions.choice: story
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain word for a teaching story.

decisions.choice: parábola (L, B); historia (R)
decisions.reason: The term used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. Readable says "historia", as the English Readable says "story" (meaning decision m1). Jesus still speaks to the leaders, so the plural "you" is the ustedes / vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: parabole (L, B); histoire (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 4 and 12: Readable names what follows as a story, as the English Readable does; 21:45 says "les histoires" in the same way.

decisions.choice: mfano (L, B); hadithi (R)
decisions.reason: The term used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage. Readable says "hadithi" (story), as the English Readable says "story" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "ngụ ngôn" (L, B); "câu chuyện" (R) for parable
decisions.reason: As settled for the Gospels (Mark 4:2; 12:1): "ngụ ngôn" is a story told to teach; Readable says "câu chuyện", as the English Readable says "story". Jesus still speaks to the leaders as "các người" (21:33-44).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 21:33-46; "비유" (L, B), "이야기" (R)
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters; respect for Jesus is carried by -시- and 께서. Readable says "story", as the English does, as in the Korean Mark 12:12.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic
alternatives: a span on every pronoun for Jesus, as in English
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God and Christ has nothing to change in Amharic. This holds through the passage.

decisions.choice: "ምሳሌ" (L, B); "ታሪክ" (R)
decisions.reason: "ምሳሌ" is the word for a parable, but in everyday speech it also means an example or a proverb; Readable calls it a story, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "दृष्टान्त" at every level
decisions.reason: "दृष्टान्त" is the established word for a parable, a story that compares and teaches; the book keeps it at every level, Readable included (as at 13:3), here and in 21:45, so the reader meets one word for Jesus' parables.

decisions.choice: "притча" at Readable too
decisions.reason: "Притча" is a current Russian word for a teaching story, so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "story".

decisions.choice: "притча" at every level
decisions.reason: Parable is "притча" at every level in the Gospels, Readable included, where the English Readable says "story"; the word is familiar in Ukrainian. Used so through Matthew 21-25.

decisions.choice: "たとえ" (every level)
decisions.reason: "たとえ" is the word for Jesus' parables through the Gospels in Japanese and is already plain, so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "story", as in Mark 12:1.

source.text: Ἄνθρωπος ἦν οἰκοδεσπότης ὅστις ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα καὶ φραγμὸν αὐτῷ περιέθηκεν καὶ ὤρυξεν ἐν αὐτῷ ληνὸν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργον, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν.

records.literal_gloss: A man there was a master of a house who planted a vineyard and a fence it placed around and dug in it a winepress and built a tower, and rented out it to farmers, and traveled abroad.

en.L: There was a man, a master of a house, who planted a vineyard and put a fence around it and dug a winepress in it and built a tower, and leased it to farmers and went abroad.
en.B: A man who owned an estate planted a vineyard. He set a hedge around it, cut a pit for a winepress, and put up a watchtower. Then he leased it to tenant farmers and went abroad.
en.R: A man owned some land, and he planted grapevines on it. He put a fence around the vineyard. He dug out a place to crush the grapes. He built a tall tower so a guard could watch over it. Then he let some farmers use the vineyard and pay him rent. After that he went away to another country.

es.L: Había un hombre, señor de una casa, que plantó una viña, y le puso una cerca alrededor, y cavó en ella un lagar, y construyó una torre, y la dio en arriendo a agricultores, y se fue al extranjero.
es.B: Un hombre que tenía una hacienda plantó una viña. La rodeó con un cerco, excavó un lagar y levantó una torre de vigilancia. Luego se la arrendó a unos agricultores y se fue al extranjero.
es.R: Un hombre tenía un terreno, y allí plantó una viña. Le puso una cerca alrededor. Cavó un lugar para aplastar las uvas. Construyó una torre alta para que un guardia pudiera vigilar la viña. Después dejó que unos agricultores usaran la viña a cambio de pagarle una renta. Luego se fue a otro país.

fr.L: Il y avait un homme, un maître de maison, qui a planté une vigne, l’a entourée d’une clôture, y a creusé un pressoir et a bâti une tour ; puis il l’a louée à des vignerons et est parti à l’étranger.
fr.B: Un propriétaire a planté une vigne. Il l’a entourée d’une haie, y a creusé une cuve pour le pressoir et a bâti une tour de garde. Puis il l’a louée à des vignerons et s’en est allé dans un autre pays.
fr.R: Un homme avait un terrain, et il y a planté de la vigne. Il a mis une clôture tout autour. Il a creusé un trou dans la roche pour écraser le raisin. Il a construit une haute tour d’où un gardien pouvait surveiller la vigne. Ensuite, il a laissé des cultivateurs s’occuper de la vigne, et ils devaient lui payer un loyer. Puis il est parti dans un autre pays.

sw.L: Palikuwa na mtu, bwana wa nyumba, ambaye alipanda shamba la mizabibu, akaweka ua kulizunguka, akachimba ndani yake kisima cha kukamulia zabibu, akajenga mnara, akalikodisha kwa wakulima, akaenda ng'ambo.
sw.B: Mtu mmoja aliyekuwa na ardhi alipanda shamba la mizabibu. Akaweka ua kulizunguka, akachonga shimo la kukamulia zabibu, akajenga mnara wa ulinzi. Kisha akawakodishia wakulima shamba hilo, akaenda ng'ambo.
sw.R: Mtu mmoja alikuwa na ardhi, akapanda mizabibu ndani yake. Aliweka ua kulizunguka shamba hilo. Alichimba mahali pa kukamulia zabibu. Alijenga mnara mrefu ili mlinzi aweze kulilinda shamba. Kisha aliwaruhusu wakulima fulani walitumie shamba hilo na kumlipa kodi. Baada ya hapo alisafiri kwenda nchi nyingine.

vi.L: Có một người chủ nhà trồng một vườn nho, dựng hàng rào chung quanh, đào một chỗ ép nho trong vườn, xây một tháp canh, rồi cho các tá điền thuê, và đi xa.
vi.B: Có một người chủ đất trồng một vườn nho. Ông làm hàng rào bao quanh, đục một bể ép nho và xây một tháp canh. Rồi ông cho các tá điền thuê vườn nho và đi sang nước khác.
vi.R: Có một người kia có một khu đất. Ông trồng nho trên đó và làm hàng rào chung quanh vườn nho. Ông đục một cái hố trong đá để ép nho. Ông xây một cái tháp cao để người canh gác trông chừng vườn nho. Rồi ông cho mấy người nông dân thuê vườn nho để họ trồng trọt và trả tiền thuê cho ông. Sau đó ông đi một chuyến xa sang nước khác.

ko.L: 한 사람이 있었는데, 그는 집주인이었다. 그는 포도원을 일구고, 그 둘레에 울타리를 두르고, 그 안에 포도즙 틀을 파고, 망대를 세웠다. 그리고 그것을 농부들에게 세를 주고 먼 나라로 떠났다.
ko.B: 어떤 땅 주인이 포도원을 만들었다. 그는 그 둘레에 울타리를 치고, 포도즙 짜는 구덩이를 파고, 망대도 세웠다. 그러고 나서 그 포도원을 농부들에게 세를 주고 다른 나라로 떠났다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람에게 땅이 있었다. 그는 그 땅에 포도나무를 심었다. 그리고 포도밭 둘레에 울타리를 쳤다. 또 포도를 밟아 즙을 짜는 구덩이를 바위에 팠다. 그리고 지키는 사람이 포도밭을 내려다볼 수 있는 높은 탑도 세웠다. 그다음에 그 포도밭을 농부들에게 빌려주고 세를 받기로 했다. 그러고는 먼 나라로 떠났다.

pt.L: Havia um homem, senhor de uma casa, que plantou uma vinha, pôs uma cerca ao redor dela, cavou nela um lagar e construiu uma torre; e a arrendou a agricultores e partiu para longe.
pt.B: Um proprietário de terras plantou uma vinha. Pôs uma cerca viva ao redor dela, cavou um tanque para o lagar e levantou uma torre de vigia. Depois arrendou a vinha a agricultores e viajou para o estrangeiro.
pt.R: Um homem tinha um terreno e plantou nele uma vinha. Ele colocou uma cerca em volta da vinha. Cavou um lugar para amassar as uvas. Construiu uma torre alta para que um vigia pudesse tomar conta da vinha. Depois deixou alguns agricultores usarem a vinha e pagarem aluguel a ele. Então viajou para outro país.

am.L: የቤት ጌታ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም የወይን ቦታ ተከለ፤ በዙሪያውም አጥር አጠረ፤ በውስጡም መጭመቂያ ቆፈረ፤ ማማም ሠራ፤ ለገበሬዎችም አከራይቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።
am.B: ሰፊ ርስት የነበረው አንድ ሰው የወይን ቦታ ተከለ። በዙሪያው ቅጥር አጠረ፤ የወይን መጭመቂያ ጉድጓድ ቆፈረ፤ የጥበቃ ማማም ሠራ። ከዚያም ለተከራይ ገበሬዎች አከራይቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።
am.R: አንድ ሰው መሬት ነበረው፤ በእርሱም ላይ የወይን ተክል ተከለ። በወይን ቦታው ዙሪያ አጥር አጠረ። ወይኑን የሚጨምቁበት ጉድጓድ ቆፈረ። ጠባቂ የሚቆምበት ረጅም ማማም ሠራ። ከዚያም ገበሬዎች የወይን ቦታውን እንዲጠቀሙበትና ኪራይ እንዲከፍሉት ሰጣቸው። ከዚያ በኋላ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

ru.L: Был человек, хозяин дома, который насадил виноградник, и оградой его обнёс, и выкопал в нём давильню, и построил башню, и сдал его земледельцам, и уехал.
ru.B: Один землевладелец посадил виноградник. Он обнёс его оградой, выдолбил яму для давильни и построил сторожевую башню. Потом он сдал виноградник в аренду земледельцам и уехал в другую страну.
ru.R: У одного человека была земля, и он посадил на ней виноград. Он сделал вокруг виноградника забор. Он выкопал яму, где давят виноград. Он построил высокую башню, чтобы сторож мог охранять виноградник. Потом он отдал виноградник земледельцам, чтобы они работали там и платили ему за это. После этого он уехал в другую страну.

hi.L: एक मनुष्य था, एक घर का स्वामी, जिसने दाख की बारी लगाई और उसके चारों ओर बाड़ा बाँधा और उसमें रस का कुंड खोदा और एक मीनार बनाई, और उसे किसानों को ठेके पर दे दिया और परदेश चला गया।
hi.B: एक ज़मींदार ने दाख की बारी लगाई। उसने उसके चारों ओर बाड़ लगाई, अंगूर रौंदने का कुंड खोदा, और पहरे की एक मीनार बनाई। फिर उसने उसे बटाईदार किसानों को ठेके पर दे दिया और परदेश चला गया।
hi.R: एक आदमी के पास कुछ ज़मीन थी, और उसने उसमें अंगूर की बेलें लगाईं। उसने बाग़ के चारों ओर बाड़ लगाई। उसने अंगूरों को कुचलने के लिए एक गड्ढा खोदा। उसने एक ऊँची मीनार बनाई ताकि एक पहरेदार बाग़ की रखवाली कर सके। फिर उसने कुछ किसानों को बाग़ दे दिया कि वे उसमें काम करें और उसे किराया दें। इसके बाद वह दूसरे देश चला गया।

uk.L: Був [один] чоловік, господар дому, який насадив виноградник, і поставив довкола нього огорожу, і викопав у ньому давильню, і збудував башту, і віддав його виноградарям, і відʼїхав у чужий край.
uk.B: Один чоловік, власник маєтку, насадив виноградник. Він обгородив його живоплотом, видовбав яму для давильні і збудував сторожову башту. Потім він здав виноградник в оренду виноградарям і відʼїхав до іншої країни.
uk.R: Один чоловік мав землю і посадив на ній виноград. Він поставив довкола виноградника огорожу. Він видовбав у скелі яму, щоб чавити в ній виноград. Він збудував високу башту, звідки сторож міг пильнувати виноградник. Потім він здав виноградник в оренду селянам. А тоді вирушив до іншої країни.

ja.L: 家の主人である一人の人がいた。その人はぶどう園を植え、その周りに囲いを巡らし、その中に酒ぶねを掘り、塔を建て、それを小作人たちに貸して、外国へ旅立った。
ja.B: ある地主がぶどう園を造った。周りに生け垣を巡らし、ぶどうを搾る穴を掘り、見張りの塔も建てた。そして、そのぶどう園を小作人たちに貸して、よその国へ出かけた。
ja.R: ある人が土地を持っていて、そこにぶどうの木を植えた。そして、そのぶどう園の周りに囲いを作った。ぶどうを踏んで汁を搾る所を、岩を掘って作った。また、見張りの人がぶどうを守れるように、高い塔を建てた。それから、そのぶどう園を農夫たちに貸して、とれたぶどうの一部を納めさせることにした。そのあと、遠い外国へ旅に出た。

decisions.choice: planting, fence, winepress, tower: Isaiah 5:1-2
decisions.reason: Isaiah sings of a vineyard its owner prepared in just this way. There the vineyard is the house of Israel and the owner is the LORD (Isaiah 5:7). Jesus' hearers would know the song.

decisions.choice: leased it to farmers: tenants who worked the land and paid the owner part of the crop
alternatives: hired laborers paid by the day
decisions.reason: Landowners who lived far away often let land to tenant farmers, who paid rent in produce.

decisions.choice: winepress: a pit cut in the rock to tread grapes
decisions.reason: Grapes were trodden in a shallow basin, and the juice ran into a lower pit, as the verb "dug" shows.

decisions.choice: no spans for the owner or his son
alternatives: spans because they stand for God and Jesus
decisions.reason: The owner and his son are figures in a parable, so their pronouns take no deity_pronoun span, like the sower and the master in other parables.

decisions.choice: tenant farmers (B); farmers who use the vineyard and pay him rent (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show that the farmers were tenants.

decisions.choice: agricultores (L, R); arrendatarios (B, from verse 34)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is simply "farmers"; the story makes them tenants (meaning decision m2). Balanced says "arrendatarios" once the lease has been told, as the English Balanced says "tenants"; "labradores" sounds old to many readers.

decisions.choice: the parable in the passé composé at every level; narration around it in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R), with Matthew's historic presents kept at Literal ("ils lui disent", "Jésus leur dit")
alternatives: passé simple for the parable at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Jesus tells the story, so it keeps the tenses of speech, as the style guide sets and as Mark 12:1-9 does. This holds for the whole passage.

decisions.choice: des vignerons (L, B); des cultivateurs (R)
decisions.reason: As Mark 12: "vignerons" are the men who work a vineyard, and "louer à" already shows they were tenants (m2); Readable uses the plainer "cultivateurs" and says how the lease worked.

decisions.choice: kisima cha kukamulia zabibu (L); shimo la kukamulia zabibu (B); mahali pa kukamulia zabibu (R)
decisions.reason: The winepress was a pit cut in the rock where grapes were trodden (meaning decision m3). "Shinikizo" is a press and is not known to most readers; the phrase says what the place was for.

decisions.choice: "tá điền" (L, B); "nông dân" (R) for the tenant farmers (whole parable)
decisions.reason: As in the parallel, Mark 12:1: "tá điền" is a farmer who works another's land for a share of the crop, the arrangement the meaning decision describes; Readable uses the plain "nông dân" and says what the lease was.

decisions.choice: "người chủ nhà" (L); "người chủ đất" (B), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Greek names him master of a house; Balanced says what he owned in the story, an estate, as the English Balanced does. "Người" here is a particular man in the story, so no setting applies.

decisions.choice: "집주인" (L), "땅 주인" (B); "포도원" (L, B), "포도밭" (R); "포도즙 틀" (L), "포도즙 짜는 구덩이" (B); "망대" (L, B); "농부들에게 세를 주다"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 12:1, which tells the same parable; "집주인" as in the Korean Matthew 13:52. The tenants worked the land and paid part of the crop (meaning decision); "세를 주다" says it in plain Korean.

decisions.choice: um lagar (L); um tanque para o lagar (B); um lugar para amassar as uvas (R)
decisions.reason: "Lagar" is the Portuguese word for the place where grapes are trodden. Balanced adds "tanque" because the verb "dug" shows a pit (m3); Readable describes it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: arrendou a vinha a agricultores
decisions.reason: The English Balanced says "tenant farmers". In Portuguese the verb "arrendar" already says that the farmers rent the land, so the noun can stay plain; "arrendatários" is a legal word.

decisions.choice: "መጭመቂያ" (winepress); "ማማ" (tower); "ገበሬዎች" (L, R), "ተከራይ ገበሬዎች" (B)
decisions.reason: "ማማ" is a raised watch post over a field, which is what this tower was; "ግንብ" suggests a fortified wall. Balanced names the farmers as tenants, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "बटाईदार किसान" (B)
decisions.reason: The farmers were tenants who paid the owner part of the crop (meaning decision m2); "बटाईदार" is the Hindi word for exactly that arrangement. The owner and his son are figures in a parable and take the plain pronoun.

decisions.choice: "виноградарі" (L, B); "селяни" (R) for the tenants
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12: the Greek word means farmers; in a vineyard the natural Ukrainian word is "виноградарі", and "здав в оренду" carries the lease. Used for the tenants through the parable (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "小作人たち" (L, B); "農夫たち" (R); the lease explained at R
decisions.reason: The farmers work land they do not own and owe the owner part of the crop (m2); "小作人" says exactly that. Readable uses the simpler "農夫" and says what the lease meant, as in Mark 12:1.

decisions.choice: "酒ぶね" (L); "ぶどうを搾る穴" (B); explained (R)
decisions.reason: The winepress was a pit cut in the rock where grapes were trodden (m3). Literal keeps a short name for it; Balanced and Readable say what it was. Mark 12:1 names the pit under the press, Matthew the press itself.

source.text: ὅτε δὲ ἤγγισεν ὁ καιρὸς τῶν καρπῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς λαβεῖν τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: When then drew near the season of the fruits, he sent the slaves of him to the farmers to receive the fruits of him.

en.L: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his slaves to the farmers to receive his fruits.
en.B: When harvest time came near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the crop.
en.R: When it was time to pick the grapes, the owner sent his servants to the farmers to get his share of the grapes.

es.L: Y cuando se acercó el tiempo de los frutos, envió a sus esclavos a los agricultores para recibir sus frutos.
es.B: Cuando se acercaba la cosecha, envió a sus siervos a los arrendatarios para cobrar la parte de la cosecha que le correspondía.
es.R: Cuando llegó el tiempo de recoger las uvas, el dueño envió a sus siervos a los agricultores para recibir su parte de las uvas.

fr.L: Et quand le temps des fruits s’est approché, il a envoyé ses esclaves aux vignerons pour recevoir ses fruits.
fr.B: Quand le temps de la récolte est arrivé, il a envoyé ses serviteurs chez les vignerons pour recevoir sa part de la récolte.
fr.R: Quand le moment de cueillir le raisin est arrivé, le propriétaire a envoyé ses serviteurs chez les cultivateurs pour recevoir sa part du raisin.

sw.L: Basi msimu wa matunda ulipokaribia, aliwatuma watumwa wake kwa wakulima wachukue matunda yake.
sw.B: Wakati wa mavuno ulipokaribia, aliwatuma watumishi wake kwa wakulima ili wachukue sehemu yake ya mavuno.
sw.R: Wakati wa kuchuma zabibu ulipofika, mwenye shamba aliwatuma watumishi wake kwa wakulima ili wampatie sehemu yake ya zabibu.

vi.L: Và khi mùa hoa lợi đến gần, ông sai các nô lệ của mình đến với các tá điền để nhận hoa lợi của mình.
vi.B: Khi gần đến mùa thu hoạch, ông sai các đầy tớ đến với các tá điền để thu phần hoa lợi của mình.
vi.R: Khi đến mùa hái nho, ông chủ sai các đầy tớ đến với những người nông dân để lấy phần nho của ông.

ko.L: 그리고 열매의 때가 가까이 오자, 그는 자기 열매를 받으려고 자기 종들을 농부들에게 보냈다.
ko.B: 수확할 때가 다가오자, 주인은 자기 몫의 소출을 받아 오게 하려고 종들을 농부들에게 보냈다.
ko.R: 포도를 딸 때가 되었다. 주인은 자기 몫의 포도를 받아 오게 하려고 종들을 농부들에게 보냈다.

pt.L: E, quando se aproximou o tempo dos frutos, enviou os seus escravos aos agricultores para receber os frutos que eram dele.
pt.B: Quando chegou perto o tempo da colheita, ele enviou os seus servos aos agricultores para receber a sua parte da colheita.
pt.R: Quando chegou o tempo de colher as uvas, o dono mandou os seus servos aos agricultores para pegar a parte das uvas que era dele.

am.L: የፍሬውም ጊዜ በቀረበ ጊዜ ፍሬዎቹን ይቀበሉ ዘንድ ባሪያዎቹን ወደ ገበሬዎቹ ላከ።
am.B: የመከር ጊዜ በቀረበ ጊዜ ከሰብሉ ድርሻውን እንዲቀበሉ ባሪያዎቹን ወደ ተከራዮቹ ላከ።
am.R: ወይኑ የሚለቀምበት ጊዜ በደረሰ ጊዜ ባለቤቱ ከወይኑ ድርሻውን እንዲያመጡለት ባሪያዎቹን ወደ ገበሬዎቹ ላከ።

ru.L: Когда же приблизилось время плодов, он послал рабов своих к земледельцам получить плоды его.
ru.B: Когда приблизилось время урожая, он послал своих рабов к арендаторам, чтобы получить свою долю урожая.
ru.R: Когда пришло время собирать виноград, хозяин послал своих рабов к земледельцам, чтобы получить свою часть урожая.

hi.L: और जब फलों का समय निकट आया, तो उसने अपने दासों को किसानों के पास भेजा कि उसके फल ले लें।
hi.B: जब फ़सल का समय पास आया, तो उसने अपने दासों को बटाईदारों के पास भेजा कि वे फ़सल में से उसका हिस्सा ले आएँ।
hi.R: जब अंगूर तोड़ने का समय आया, तो मालिक ने अपने दासों को किसानों के पास भेजा कि वे अंगूरों में से उसका हिस्सा ले आएँ।

uk.L: А коли наблизилася пора плодів, він послав своїх рабів до виноградарів, щоб узяти його плоди.
uk.B: Коли наблизилася пора збору, він послав своїх рабів до виноградарів, щоб отримати свою частку врожаю.
uk.R: Коли настав час збирати виноград, господар послав до селян своїх рабів. Вони мали забрати його частину врожаю.

ja.L: そして、実りの時期が近づいたとき、彼は自分の実を受け取るために、自分の奴隷たちを小作人たちのところへ遣わした。
ja.B: 収穫の時期が近づくと、主人は自分の分の収穫を受け取ろうとして、しもべたちを小作人たちのところへ遣わした。
ja.R: ぶどうをとり入れる時が来ると、持ち主は、自分の分のぶどうを受け取ってくるように、しもべたちを農夫たちのところへ送った。

decisions.choice: slaves: the owner's slaves, sent with his authority
decisions.reason: The word means a slave, a person owned by a master. The prophets are called God's slaves (Jeremiah 7:25; Amos 3:7), and the story points to them.

decisions.choice: his fruits: the share of the crop that belonged to the owner
decisions.reason: The pronoun most naturally refers to the owner. Under a lease he was owed part of the harvest.

decisions.choice: his share of the crop (B); his share of the grapes (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the owner was owed.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that they were owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: esclavos (L); siervos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage: the owner's slaves act for him (meaning decision m1), as servants sent with his authority.

decisions.choice: esclaves (L); serviteurs (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms, as the English and Mark 12: Literal keeps that the men were owned (m1), Balanced and Readable say "serviteurs", the role they play as the owner's envoys. This holds for the whole parable.

decisions.choice: watumwa (L); watumishi (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms used throughout Matthew, recorded once in this passage: the owner's slaves act for him (meaning decision m1), as servants sent with his authority.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R) for doulos (whole parable)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for doulos and as in Mark 12:2: Literal keeps the hard edge of the word, Balanced and Readable avoid the picture of modern slavery.

decisions.choice: "종" at every level for doulos, through this parable
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 12:2: Korean "종" already says one owned and sent with the master's authority.

decisions.choice: "자기 몫의 소출" (B); "자기 몫의 포도" (R); "자기 열매" (L)
decisions.reason: His fruits are the share of the crop that belonged to the owner (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: escravos (L); servos (B, R)
decisions.reason: As docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6, and the English: Literal keeps "escravo"; Balanced and Readable say "servo", the word for those who serve a master with his authority, while m1 keeps that they were owned. In 20:27, where slavery itself was the point, every level said "escravo".

decisions.choice: os frutos que eram dele
decisions.reason: "Os seus frutos" could be read as the farmers' fruit. Literal says "que eram dele" so that the owner is plainly meant (m2).

decisions.choice: "ባሪያዎች" at Balanced and Readable too
alternatives: "አገልጋዮች" (servants), as the English Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "ባሪያ" for the Greek word at every level; these are the owner's own men, sent with his authority, and the story turns on their being his.

decisions.choice: "दास" at every level
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "दास" for doulos at every level; these men were owned by the landowner and sent with his authority (meaning decision m1), and the word does not sound harsh in Hindi.

decisions.choice: "рабы" at every level
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "раб" for "doulos" at every level, where the English Balanced and Readable say "servants": the owner sends men he owns, with his authority.

decisions.choice: "раб" at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12, the Ukrainian keeps "раб" for doulos where the English Balanced and Readable say "servant": the men belong to the owner and come in his name (meaning decision m1), and "слуга" would lose that. Used so through Matthew 21-25.

decisions.choice: "奴隷たち" (L); "しもべたち" (B, R)
decisions.reason: They are owned by their master and act in his name (m1). As in the rest of Open Word Bible, Literal says slave and Balanced and Readable servant; the same in 21:35-36.

decisions.choice: the parable told in the plain style at Readable too
decisions.reason: Jesus tells the story, and his speech is plain at every level, so the parable's narration keeps the plain past ("送った") at Readable, as in Mark 12:2.

source.text: καὶ λαβόντες οἱ γεωργοὶ τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ὃν μὲν ἔδειραν, ὃν δὲ ἀπέκτειναν, ὃν δὲ ἐλιθοβόλησαν.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken the farmers the slaves of him, one they beat, another they killed, another they stoned.

en.L: And the farmers, taking his slaves, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
en.B: The tenants grabbed his servants. One they beat up, another they killed, and another they pelted with stones.
en.R: But the farmers grabbed the owner's servants. They beat one of them. They killed another one. And they threw stones at another one.

es.L: Y los agricultores, agarrando a sus esclavos, a uno lo apalearon, a otro lo mataron y a otro lo apedrearon.
es.B: Los arrendatarios agarraron a sus siervos. A uno le dieron una paliza, a otro lo mataron y a otro lo atacaron a pedradas.
es.R: Pero los agricultores agarraron a los siervos del dueño. A uno lo golpearon. A otro lo mataron. Y a otro le tiraron piedras.

fr.L: Et les vignerons, ayant saisi ses esclaves, ont battu l’un, ont tué l’autre, et ont lapidé l’autre.
fr.B: Les vignerons se sont saisis de ses serviteurs : ils ont roué de coups l’un, tué un autre et lapidé un troisième.
fr.R: Mais les cultivateurs ont attrapé les serviteurs du propriétaire. Ils ont frappé l’un d’eux. Ils ont tué un autre. Et ils ont jeté des pierres sur un autre.

sw.L: Na wakulima, wakiwa wamewashika watumwa wake, huyu walimchapa, yule walimuua, na mwingine walimpiga mawe.
sw.B: Wakulima waliwakamata watumishi wake. Mmoja wakamchapa vibaya, mwingine wakamuua, na mwingine wakamtupia mawe.
sw.R: Lakini wakulima waliwakamata watumishi wa mwenye shamba. Mmoja walimpiga. Mwingine walimuua. Na mwingine walimtupia mawe.

vi.L: Và các tá điền bắt các nô lệ của ông, đánh người này, giết người kia, và ném đá người khác.
vi.B: Các tá điền bắt các đầy tớ của ông: họ đánh người này, giết người kia, và ném đá người khác.
vi.R: Nhưng những người nông dân bắt các đầy tớ của ông chủ. Họ đánh một người. Họ giết một người khác. Rồi họ lấy đá ném vào một người nữa.

ko.L: 그러자 농부들이 그의 종들을 붙잡아, 하나는 때리고, 하나는 죽이고, 하나는 돌로 쳤다.
ko.B: 그런데 농부들은 그 종들을 붙잡아서, 하나는 때리고, 하나는 죽이고, 또 하나는 돌로 쳤다.
ko.R: 그러나 농부들은 주인의 종들을 붙잡았다. 그리고 한 종은 때렸다. 다른 종은 죽였다. 또 다른 종에게는 돌을 던졌다.

pt.L: E os agricultores, pegando os escravos dele, a um espancaram, a outro mataram e a outro apedrejaram.
pt.B: Os agricultores agarraram os servos dele. Um eles espancaram, outro mataram e outro atacaram a pedradas.
pt.R: Mas os agricultores agarraram os servos do dono. Bateram em um deles. Mataram outro. E jogaram pedras em outro.

am.L: ገበሬዎቹም ባሪያዎቹን ይዘው አንዱን ደበደቡት፤ አንዱን ገደሉት፤ ሌላውንም በድንጋይ ወገሩት።
am.B: ተከራዮቹ ግን ባሪያዎቹን ያዙ፤ አንዱን ደበደቡት፣ ሌላውን ገደሉት፣ ሌላውንም በድንጋይ ወገሩት።
am.R: ገበሬዎቹ ግን የባለቤቱን ባሪያዎች ያዙ። አንዱን ደበደቡት። ሌላውን ገደሉት። ሌላውንም ድንጋይ ወረወሩበት።

ru.L: И земледельцы, схватив рабов его, одного избили, другого убили, иного побили камнями.
ru.B: Арендаторы схватили его рабов: одного избили, другого убили, а третьего забросали камнями.
ru.R: Но земледельцы схватили рабов хозяина. Одного они избили. Другого убили. А третьего забросали камнями.

hi.L: और किसानों ने उसके दासों को पकड़कर किसी को पीटा, किसी को मार डाला, और किसी पर पथराव किया।
hi.B: बटाईदारों ने उसके दासों को पकड़ लिया। एक को उन्होंने पीटा, दूसरे को मार डाला, और तीसरे पर पत्थर बरसाए।
hi.R: पर किसानों ने मालिक के दासों को पकड़ लिया। उन्होंने एक को पीटा। दूसरे को मार डाला। और तीसरे पर पत्थर फेंके।

uk.L: І виноградарі, схопивши його рабів, одного побили, іншого вбили, а ще іншого побили камінням.
uk.B: Виноградарі схопили його рабів: одного побили, другого вбили, а третього закидали камінням.
uk.R: Але селяни схопили рабів господаря. Одного вони побили. Другого вбили. А третього закидали камінням.

ja.L: すると小作人たちは彼の奴隷たちを捕まえて、ある者を打ちたたき、ある者を殺し、ある者を石で打った。
ja.B: ところが小作人たちは、そのしもべたちを捕まえて、一人を袋だたきにし、一人を殺し、もう一人には石を投げつけた。
ja.R: ところが農夫たちは、持ち主のしもべたちをつかまえた。そして、一人をなぐった。別の一人を殺した。もう一人には石を投げつけた。

decisions.choice: beaten, killed, stoned: the way the prophets were treated
alternatives: violence with no meaning beyond the story
decisions.reason: Zechariah son of Jehoiada was stoned in the temple court (2 Chronicles 24:21), and Jesus will speak of Jerusalem stoning those sent to her (23:37).

decisions.choice: stoned: pelted with stones, often to death
decisions.reason: Stoning was a way of putting someone to death, but the verb itself means to throw stones at someone.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: "ném đá" (L, B); "lấy đá ném vào" (R)
decisions.reason: "Ném đá" is the Bible word for stoning, which was often to death (meaning decision); Readable says what was done in plain words.

decisions.choice: "돌로 치다" (L, B); "돌을 던지다" (R)
decisions.reason: Pelted with stones, often to death (meaning decision); the Korean leaves open whether this one died, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "石で打った" (L); "石を投げつけた" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to throw stones at someone, often but not always to death (m2). Balanced and Readable say what was done without deciding that the servant died.

source.text: πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους πλείονας τῶν πρώτων, καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς ὡσαύτως.

records.literal_gloss: Again he sent other slaves more than the first, and they did to them likewise.

en.L: Again he sent other slaves, more than the first, and they did the same to them.
en.B: So the owner sent other servants, a larger group than the first, and the tenants treated them the same way.
en.R: So the owner sent more servants, more than the first time. But the farmers did the same things to them.

es.L: De nuevo envió otros esclavos, más que los primeros, y les hicieron lo mismo.
es.B: Entonces el dueño envió otros siervos, un grupo más numeroso que el primero, y los arrendatarios los trataron de la misma manera.
es.R: Así que el dueño envió más siervos, más que la primera vez. Pero los agricultores les hicieron lo mismo.

fr.L: De nouveau il a envoyé d’autres esclaves, plus nombreux que les premiers, et ils les ont traités de même.
fr.B: Le propriétaire a alors envoyé d’autres serviteurs, plus nombreux que les premiers, et les vignerons les ont traités de la même façon.
fr.R: Alors le propriétaire a envoyé d’autres serviteurs, plus nombreux que la première fois. Mais les cultivateurs leur ont fait la même chose.

sw.L: Tena alituma watumwa wengine, idadi kubwa kuliko wale wa kwanza, na wakawafanyia hivyo hivyo.
sw.B: Basi mwenye shamba alituma watumishi wengine, kundi kubwa kuliko lile la kwanza, na wakulima wakawafanyia vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mwenye shamba alituma watumishi wengi zaidi kuliko mara ya kwanza. Lakini wakulima waliwafanyia mambo yale yale.

vi.L: Ông lại sai những nô lệ khác, đông hơn lần trước, và họ cũng đối xử với những người này như vậy.
vi.B: Ông chủ lại sai những đầy tớ khác, đông hơn lần đầu, nhưng các tá điền cũng đối xử với họ y như thế.
vi.R: Vì thế ông chủ sai thêm nhiều đầy tớ khác, đông hơn lần trước. Nhưng những người nông dân cũng làm như vậy với họ.

ko.L: 다시 그는 처음보다 더 많은 다른 종들을 보냈다. 그러자 그들은 그 종들에게도 똑같이 하였다.
ko.B: 주인이 다시 처음보다 더 많은 종들을 보냈으나, 농부들은 그들에게도 똑같이 했다.
ko.R: 그러자 주인은 처음보다 더 많은 종들을 보냈다. 그러나 농부들은 그 종들에게도 똑같이 했다.

pt.L: De novo enviou outros escravos, mais numerosos que os primeiros, e fizeram com eles do mesmo modo.
pt.B: Então o dono enviou outros servos, em número maior que o primeiro grupo, e os agricultores os trataram da mesma maneira.
pt.R: Então o dono mandou mais servos, mais do que da primeira vez. Mas os agricultores fizeram as mesmas coisas com eles.

am.L: ደግሞም ከፊተኞቹ የበዙ ሌሎች ባሪያዎችን ላከ፤ በእነርሱም ላይ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ባለቤቱ ከመጀመሪያዎቹ የሚበልጡ ሌሎች ባሪያዎችን ላከ፤ ተከራዮቹም በእነርሱ ላይ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ባለቤቱ ከመጀመሪያው የበለጡ ብዙ ባሪያዎችን ላከ። ገበሬዎቹ ግን በእነርሱም ላይ እንደዚያው አደረጉ።

ru.L: Снова он послал других рабов, больше, чем прежних, и они поступили с ними так же.
ru.B: Тогда хозяин послал других рабов, больше, чем в первый раз, и арендаторы обошлись с ними так же.
ru.R: Тогда хозяин послал ещё рабов, больше, чем в первый раз. Но земледельцы сделали с ними то же самое.

hi.L: फिर उसने पहलों से अधिक दूसरे दास भेजे, और उन्होंने उनके साथ भी वैसा ही किया।
hi.B: तब मालिक ने और दास भेजे, पहले से ज़्यादा, और बटाईदारों ने उनके साथ भी वैसा ही बर्ताव किया।
hi.R: तब मालिक ने और दास भेजे, पहली बार से ज़्यादा। पर किसानों ने उनके साथ भी वैसा ही किया।

uk.L: Знову він послав інших рабів, більше, ніж перших, і [ті] вчинили з ними так само.
uk.B: Тоді господар послав інших рабів, більше, ніж першого разу, і виноградарі вчинили з ними так само.
uk.R: Тож господар послав ще рабів, більше, ніж першого разу. Але селяни зробили з ними те саме.

ja.L: 再び、彼は最初の者たちよりも多くの、ほかの奴隷たちを遣わした。すると[彼らは]その者たちにも同じようにした。
ja.B: そこで主人は、最初よりも大勢のしもべたちを送ったが、小作人たちは彼らにも同じことをした。
ja.R: そこで持ち主は、前よりもたくさんのしもべたちを送った。けれども農夫たちは、そのしもべたちにも同じことをした。

decisions.choice: more than the first: more in number
decisions.reason: The word can mean greater in number or in rank. Here more slaves are sent.

decisions.choice: the owner; the tenants (B), the farmers (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who sent and who acted.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it, and Literal keeps "slave".

source.text: ὕστερον δὲ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ λέγων· Ἐντραπήσονται τὸν υἱόν μου.

records.literal_gloss: Last then he sent to them the son of him saying, They will respect the son of me.

en.L: And later he sent his son to them, saying, 'They will respect my son.'
en.B: Finally he sent his son to them. He told himself, 'They will show respect to my son.'
en.R: Finally the owner sent his son to them. He thought, 'The farmers will respect my son.'

es.L: Y por último les envió a su hijo, diciendo: “Respetarán a mi hijo”.
es.B: Por último les envió a su hijo. Se dijo: “A mi hijo lo respetarán”.
es.R: Al final, el dueño les envió a su hijo. Pensó: “A mi hijo, los agricultores lo van a respetar”.

fr.L: Et en dernier, il leur a envoyé son fils, disant : “Ils respecteront mon fils.”
fr.B: Finalement, il leur a envoyé son fils, en se disant : “Ils auront du respect pour mon fils.”
fr.R: À la fin, le propriétaire a envoyé son fils chez eux. Il pensait : “Les cultivateurs vont respecter mon fils.”

sw.L: Hatimaye alimtuma kwao mwana wake, akisema, 'Watamheshimu mwanangu.'
sw.B: Mwishowe alimtuma mwanawe kwao. Akajiambia, 'Mwanangu watamheshimu.'
sw.R: Hatimaye mwenye shamba alimtuma mwanawe. Alifikiri, 'Wakulima watamheshimu mwanangu.'

vi.L: Và sau cùng ông sai con trai mình đến với họ, nói rằng: 'Họ sẽ kính nể con ta.'
vi.B: Sau cùng, ông sai con trai mình đến với họ, vì nghĩ: 'Họ sẽ tôn trọng con ta.'
vi.R: Cuối cùng, ông chủ sai con trai mình đến. Ông nghĩ: 'Những người nông dân sẽ tôn trọng con trai ta.'

ko.L: 그리고 나중에 그는 자기 아들을 그들에게 보내며 말했다. '그들이 내 아들은 존중할 것이다.'
ko.B: 마지막으로 주인은 '내 아들이야 존중하겠지' 하고 생각하며, 자기 아들을 그들에게 보냈다.
ko.R: 마지막으로 주인은 자기 아들을 농부들에게 보냈다. 주인은 '농부들도 내 아들은 존중하겠지' 하고 생각했다.

pt.L: E por último enviou a eles o seu filho, dizendo: 'Respeitarão o meu filho.'
pt.B: Por fim, ele mandou o seu filho até eles. Disse consigo mesmo: 'Eles vão respeitar o meu filho.'
pt.R: Por fim, o dono mandou o seu filho até eles. Ele pensou: 'Os agricultores vão respeitar o meu filho.'

am.L: በመጨረሻም ልጁን ወደ እነርሱ ላከ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ “ልጄን ያፍሩታል።”
am.B: በመጨረሻ ልጁን ወደ እነርሱ ላከ። በልቡም “ልጄንስ ያከብሩታል” አለ።
am.R: በመጨረሻ ባለቤቱ ልጁን ወደ እነርሱ ላከ። “ገበሬዎቹ ልጄን ያከብሩታል” ብሎ አሰበ።

ru.L: Наконец же он послал к ним сына своего, говоря: “Устыдятся сына моего.”
ru.B: Наконец он послал к ним своего сына. Он сказал себе: “К моему сыну они отнесутся с уважением.”
ru.R: Наконец хозяин послал к ним своего сына. Он думал: “Моего сына земледельцы будут уважать.”

hi.L: और अंत में उसने अपने पुत्र को उनके पास यह कहते हुए भेजा, 'वे मेरे पुत्र का आदर करेंगे।'
hi.B: आख़िर में उसने अपने पुत्र को उनके पास भेजा। उसने मन में कहा, 'वे मेरे पुत्र का तो आदर करेंगे।'
hi.R: आख़िर में मालिक ने अपने बेटे को उनके पास भेजा। उसने सोचा, 'किसान मेरे बेटे का आदर करेंगे।'

uk.L: Наостанок же він послав до них свого сина, кажучи: “Посоромляться мого сина.”
uk.B: Насамкінець він послав до них свого сина. Він думав: “Мого сина вони пошанують.”
uk.R: Нарешті господар послав до них свого сина. Він думав: “Мого сина селяни поважатимуть.”

ja.L: そして最後に、『わたしの息子なら、彼らは敬うだろう』と言って、彼は自分の息子を彼らのところへ遣わした。
ja.B: 最後に主人は、『わたしの息子なら敬ってくれるだろう』と思って、息子を彼らのところへ送った。
ja.R: 最後に持ち主は、自分の息子を農夫たちのところへ送った。『わたしの息子なら、大切にしてくれるだろう』と思ったのだ。

decisions.choice: his son: in the story, the owner's son; in its meaning, Jesus
decisions.reason: The son comes after all the slaves and is the heir (21:38). God has called Jesus his beloved Son (3:17), and the leaders see that the story is about them (21:45).

decisions.choice: later: at last, after all the others
decisions.reason: The word means afterward or finally; the son is the last one sent.

decisions.choice: respect: feel shame before, and so treat with honor
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn back in shame before someone, and so to show them respect.

decisions.choice: He told himself (B); He thought (R)
decisions.reason: The owner speaks his hope rather than giving an order, so Balanced and Readable make it his thought.

decisions.choice: "kính nể" (L); "tôn trọng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of Mark 12:6: the verb is to feel shame before someone and so treat him with honor (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "존중하다"
decisions.reason: The verb means to feel shame before someone and so treat him with honour (meaning decision); "존중하다" as in the Korean Mark 12:6. The owner's son has no honorific in the story.

decisions.choice: "敬う" (L, B); "大切にする" (R); the words before the sending at L and B
decisions.reason: The verb is to feel shame before someone and so treat him with honor (m3). The words match Mark 12:6. Japanese puts what the owner says or thinks before the verb of sending.

source.text: οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἰδόντες τὸν υἱὸν εἶπον ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος· δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτὸν καὶ σχῶμεν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: The but farmers having seen the son said among themselves, This is the heir; come let us kill him and let us have the inheritance of him;

en.L: But the farmers, seeing the son, said among themselves, 'This is the heir; come, let us kill him and have his inheritance.'
en.B: The tenants, though, saw the son and said to one another, 'Here is the one who will inherit the vineyard. Come on, if we kill him, his inheritance will be ours.'
en.R: But when the farmers saw the son, they talked among themselves. They said, 'This son will own the vineyard someday. Let us kill him! Then the vineyard will belong to us.'

es.L: Pero los agricultores, al ver al hijo, dijeron entre sí: “Este es el heredero; {{plural_you:vengan|venid}}, matémoslo y quedémonos con su herencia”.
es.B: Pero cuando los arrendatarios vieron al hijo, se dijeron unos a otros: “Este es el que va a heredar la viña. {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, si lo matamos, su herencia será nuestra”.
es.R: Pero cuando los agricultores vieron al hijo, hablaron entre ellos. Dijeron: “Este hijo va a ser el dueño de la viña algún día. ¡Vamos a matarlo! Así la viña será nuestra”.

fr.L: Mais les vignerons, voyant le fils, se sont dit entre eux : “Celui-ci est l’héritier ; venez, tuons-le et ayons son héritage.”
fr.B: Mais en voyant le fils, les vignerons se sont dit les uns aux autres : “C’est lui qui doit hériter de la vigne. Allons, tuons-le, et son héritage sera à nous !”
fr.R: Mais quand les cultivateurs ont vu le fils, ils se sont parlé entre eux. Ils ont dit : “C’est le fils qui recevra la vigne un jour. Tuons-le ! Comme ça, la vigne sera à nous !”

sw.L: Lakini wakulima, wakimwona mwana, wakasema miongoni mwao, 'Huyu ni mrithi; njooni, tumuue, tuwe na urithi wake.'
sw.B: Lakini wakulima walipomwona mwana huyo, waliambiana, 'Huyu ndiye atakayerithi shamba hili. Njooni, tukimuua, urithi wake utakuwa wetu.'
sw.R: Lakini wakulima walipomwona mwana huyo, walizungumza wao kwa wao. Walisema, 'Siku moja mwana huyu atakuwa mwenye shamba hili. Tumuue! Kisha shamba litakuwa letu.'

vi.L: Nhưng các tá điền, thấy người con, nói với nhau: 'Đây là người thừa kế; nào, chúng ta hãy giết nó và chiếm lấy gia tài của nó.'
vi.B: Nhưng khi thấy người con, các tá điền bàn với nhau: 'Đây là người sẽ thừa kế vườn nho. Nào, chúng ta giết nó đi, rồi gia tài của nó sẽ về tay chúng ta.'
vi.R: Nhưng khi những người nông dân thấy người con, họ bàn với nhau: 'Đây là người con sẽ làm chủ vườn nho sau này. Chúng ta hãy giết nó đi! Rồi vườn nho sẽ thuộc về chúng ta.'

ko.L: 그러나 농부들은 그 아들을 보고 자기들끼리 말했다. '이 사람이 상속자다. 자, 그를 죽이고 그의 유산을 차지하자.'
ko.B: 그러나 농부들은 그 아들을 보고 서로 말했다. '이 사람이 포도원을 물려받을 상속자다. 자, 저 사람을 죽여 버리자. 그러면 그의 유산은 우리 차지가 된다.'
ko.R: 그러나 농부들은 그 아들을 보고 서로 말했다. '이 사람은 나중에 이 포도밭을 물려받을 아들이다. 저 사람을 죽이자! 그러면 이 포도밭은 우리 것이 된다!'

pt.L: Mas os agricultores, vendo o filho, disseram entre si: 'Este é o herdeiro; venham, vamos matá-lo e ficar com a herança dele.'
pt.B: Mas os agricultores viram o filho e disseram uns aos outros: 'Este é quem vai herdar a vinha. Vamos lá: se o matarmos, a herança dele será nossa.'
pt.R: Mas, quando os agricultores viram o filho, conversaram entre eles. Disseram: 'Um dia este filho vai ser o dono da vinha. Vamos matá-lo! Assim a vinha vai ficar para nós.'

am.L: ገበሬዎቹ ግን ልጁን አይተው እርስ በርሳቸው እንዲህ ተባባሉ፦ “ይህ ወራሹ ነው፤ ኑ፣ እንግደለውና ርስቱን እንያዝ።”
am.B: ተከራዮቹ ግን ልጁን ባዩ ጊዜ እርስ በርሳቸው “የወይን ቦታውን የሚወርሰው ይህ ነው። ኑ፣ ብንገድለው ርስቱ የእኛ ይሆናል” ተባባሉ።
am.R: ገበሬዎቹ ግን ልጁን ባዩ ጊዜ እርስ በርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ። “ይህ ልጅ አንድ ቀን የወይን ቦታው ባለቤት ይሆናል። ኑ፣ እንግደለው! ከዚያም የወይን ቦታው የእኛ ይሆናል” አሉ።

ru.L: Земледельцы же, увидев сына, сказали между собой: “Это наследник; давайте убьём его и завладеем наследством его.”
ru.B: Но арендаторы, увидев сына, сказали друг другу: “Вот тот, кто унаследует виноградник. Давайте убьём его, и его наследство будет нашим.”
ru.R: Но когда земледельцы увидели сына, они стали говорить между собой: “Этот сын когда-нибудь будет хозяином виноградника. Давайте убьём его! Тогда виноградник станет нашим.”

hi.L: पर किसानों ने पुत्र को देखकर आपस में कहा, 'यह तो वारिस है; आओ, इसे मार डालें और इसकी विरासत ले लें।'
hi.B: पर बटाईदारों ने पुत्र को देखकर एक-दूसरे से कहा, 'यही है जो दाख की बारी का वारिस बनेगा। चलो, अगर हम इसे मार डालें, तो इसकी विरासत हमारी हो जाएगी।'
hi.R: पर जब किसानों ने बेटे को देखा, तो उन्होंने आपस में बात की। उन्होंने कहा, 'एक दिन यही बेटा इस बाग़ का मालिक बनेगा। आओ, इसे मार डालें! फिर बाग़ हमारा हो जाएगा।'

uk.L: А виноградарі, побачивши сина, сказали між собою: “Це спадкоємець; ходімо, вбʼємо його і заволодіємо його спадщиною.”
uk.B: Але виноградарі, побачивши сина, сказали одне одному: “Ось той, хто успадкує виноградник. Ходімо вбʼємо його, і його спадщина буде наша.”
uk.R: Але коли селяни побачили сина, вони почали радитися між собою. Вони сказали: “Цей син колись володітиме виноградником. Убʼємо його! Тоді виноградник буде наш.”

ja.L: しかし小作人たちは息子を見て、互いに言った。『これは跡取りだ。さあ、彼を殺して、彼の相続財産を手に入れよう。』
ja.B: ところが小作人たちは、その息子を見て話し合った。『あれがぶどう園の跡取りだ。さあ、殺してしまおう。そうすれば、相続財産はおれたちのものになる。』
ja.R: けれども農夫たちは、その息子を見て、互いに言い合った。『あれは、いつかこのぶどう園の持ち主になる息子だ。あいつを殺そう！そうすれば、ぶどう園はおれたちのものだ！』

decisions.choice: kill the heir and take the inheritance: a scheme to keep the land
decisions.reason: With the heir dead and the owner far away, the tenants hope the land will be left to those who hold it.

decisions.choice: come, let us kill him: the words of Joseph's brothers
decisions.reason: Joseph's brothers said almost the same when they saw him coming (Genesis 37:20 in the Greek Old Testament).

decisions.choice: the vineyard
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the son would inherit.

decisions.choice: "nó" for the son in the tenants' words
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:7: the tenants who plot his death speak of him with the contemptuous "nó", while the narrator calls him "người con".

decisions.choice: "자, 그를 죽이자" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The words echo Joseph's brothers (meaning decision); the plain Korean exhortation "자" keeps the same words as the Korean Mark 12:7.

decisions.choice: "おれたち" (B, R); no pronoun (L)
decisions.reason: The tenants plot among themselves as rough men; Balanced and Readable give them blunt speech, as in Mark 12:7.

source.text: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἐξέβαλον ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος καὶ ἀπέκτειναν.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken him they cast out outside of the vineyard and killed.

en.L: And taking him, they threw [him] out of the vineyard and killed [him].
en.B: They took hold of him, forced him outside the vineyard, and killed him.
en.R: So they grabbed the son and threw him out of the vineyard. Then they killed him.

es.L: Y agarrándolo, [lo] arrojaron fuera de la viña y [lo] mataron.
es.B: Lo agarraron, lo sacaron a la fuerza de la viña y lo mataron.
es.R: Entonces agarraron al hijo y lo echaron de la viña. Después lo mataron.

fr.L: Et l’ayant saisi, ils [l’]ont jeté hors de la vigne et [l’]ont tué.
fr.B: Ils se sont saisis de lui, l’ont poussé hors de la vigne et l’ont tué.
fr.R: Alors ils ont attrapé le fils et l’ont jeté hors de la vigne. Puis ils l’ont tué.

sw.L: Na baada ya kumshika, walimtupa nje ya shamba la mizabibu, na kumuua.
sw.B: Wakamshika, wakamsukuma nje ya shamba la mizabibu, kisha wakamuua.
sw.R: Basi wakamkamata mwana huyo na kumtoa nje ya shamba. Kisha wakamuua.

vi.L: Và họ bắt lấy, quăng ra ngoài vườn nho, rồi giết đi.
vi.B: Thế là họ bắt anh ấy, lôi ra ngoài vườn nho và giết đi.
vi.R: Vậy họ bắt người con và lôi anh ra khỏi vườn nho. Rồi họ giết anh.

ko.L: 그리고 그를 붙잡아 포도원 밖으로 내쫓고 죽였다.
ko.B: 그들은 그 아들을 붙잡아 포도원 밖으로 끌어내고 죽였다.
ko.R: 그래서 농부들은 그 아들을 붙잡아 포도밭 밖으로 내쫓았다. 그리고 그를 죽였다.

pt.L: E, pegando-o, lançaram[-no] fora da vinha e [o] mataram.
pt.B: Eles o agarraram, o arrastaram para fora da vinha e o mataram.
pt.R: Então agarraram o filho e o jogaram para fora da vinha. Depois o mataram.

am.L: ይዘውም ከወይን ቦታው ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፤ ገደሉትም።
am.B: ያዙት፤ ከወይን ቦታውም ወደ ውጭ ጎትተው አውጥተው ገደሉት።
am.R: ስለዚህ ልጁን ይዘው ከወይን ቦታው ወደ ውጭ ወረወሩት። ከዚያም ገደሉት።

ru.L: И, схватив его, выбросили вон из виноградника и убили.
ru.B: Они схватили его, вытолкали за пределы виноградника и убили.
ru.R: И они схватили сына и выбросили его из виноградника. Потом они убили его.

hi.L: और उसे पकड़कर उन्होंने दाख की बारी से बाहर निकाल दिया और मार डाला।
hi.B: उन्होंने उसे पकड़ा, घसीटकर दाख की बारी से बाहर ले गए, और उसे मार डाला।
hi.R: तो उन्होंने बेटे को पकड़ लिया और उसे बाग़ से बाहर फेंक दिया। फिर उन्होंने उसे मार डाला।

uk.L: І, схопивши його, викинули [його] геть із виноградника і вбили [його].
uk.B: Вони схопили його, вивели за межі виноградника і вбили.
uk.R: Тож вони схопили сина й викинули з виноградника. А тоді вбили його.

ja.L: そして彼らは彼を捕まえて、ぶどう園の外に放り出し、[彼を]殺した。
ja.B: そして、息子を捕まえてぶどう園の外に引きずり出し、殺してしまった。
ja.R: そこで農夫たちは、息子をつかまえて、ぶどう園の外に放り出した。そして、息子を殺した。

decisions.choice: thrown out and then killed: the son dies outside the vineyard
decisions.reason: Mark 12:8 has the son killed and then thrown out. Matthew's order may look ahead to Jesus' death outside the city (27:31-33; Hebrews 13:12).

decisions.choice: "bắt lấy, quăng ra ... rồi giết đi" (L) with no brackets
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:3: Vietnamese, like the Greek, can leave the object unstated when the sentence makes it plain, so the English bracketed "[him]" has nothing to supply. The order, thrown out and then killed, is kept (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Thrown out first, then killed, at every level
alternatives: killed and then thrown out, as in Mark 12:8
decisions.reason: Matthew's order: the son dies outside the vineyard (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: thrown out, then killed, at every level
decisions.reason: Matthew's order differs from Mark 12:8, where the son is killed and then thrown out, and may look ahead to Jesus' death outside the city (m1). Japanese keeps Matthew's order and does not follow Mark's wording here.

source.text: ὅταν οὖν ἔλθῃ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος, τί ποιήσει τοῖς γεωργοῖς ἐκείνοις;

records.literal_gloss: When therefore comes the lord of the vineyard, what will he do to the farmers those?

en.L: So when the master of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?"
en.B: Now when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?"
en.R: So what will the owner of the vineyard do to those farmers when he comes back?"

es.L: Entonces, cuando llegue el amo de la viña, ¿qué les hará a esos agricultores?».
es.B: Ahora bien, cuando venga el dueño de la viña, ¿qué hará con esos arrendatarios?».
es.R: Entonces, ¿qué hará el dueño de la viña con esos agricultores cuando regrese?».

fr.L: Quand donc viendra le maître de la vigne, que fera-t-il à ces vignerons-là ? »
fr.B: Quand le propriétaire de la vigne viendra, que fera-t-il donc à ces vignerons ? »
fr.R: Alors, que va faire le propriétaire de la vigne à ces cultivateurs quand il reviendra ? »

sw.L: Basi bwana wa shamba la mizabibu akija, atawafanyia nini wakulima hao?"
sw.B: Sasa, mwenye shamba la mizabibu atakapokuja, atawafanya nini wakulima hao?"
sw.R: Basi, mwenye shamba atakaporudi, atawafanya nini wakulima hao?"

vi.L: Vậy khi chủ vườn nho đến, ông sẽ làm gì cho các tá điền ấy?"
vi.B: Vậy khi chủ vườn nho đến, ông sẽ xử những tá điền ấy thế nào?"
vi.R: Vậy khi ông chủ vườn nho trở về, ông sẽ làm gì những người nông dân đó?"

ko.L: 그러면 포도원 주인이 올 때에, 그 농부들에게 어떻게 하겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그러면 포도원 주인이 돌아올 때에, 그 농부들을 어떻게 하겠느냐?"
ko.R: 그렇다면 포도밭 주인이 돌아오면 그 농부들을 어떻게 하겠느냐?"

pt.L: Então, quando vier o senhor da vinha, que fará ele àqueles agricultores?"
pt.B: Pois bem, quando o dono da vinha vier, o que ele fará com aqueles agricultores?"
pt.R: Então o que o dono da vinha vai fazer com aqueles agricultores quando voltar?"

am.L: እንግዲህ የወይን ቦታው ጌታ በመጣ ጊዜ በእነዚያ ገበሬዎች ላይ ምን ያደርጋል?»
am.B: እንግዲህ የወይን ቦታው ባለቤት በመጣ ጊዜ በእነዚያ ተከራዮች ላይ ምን ያደርጋል?»
am.R: ታዲያ የወይን ቦታው ባለቤት ተመልሶ በመጣ ጊዜ እነዚያን ገበሬዎች ምን ያደርጋቸዋል?»

ru.L: Итак, когда придёт господин виноградника, что сделает он с теми земледельцами?»
ru.B: Так что же сделает хозяин виноградника с этими арендаторами, когда придёт?»
ru.R: Что же сделает хозяин виноградника с этими земледельцами, когда вернётся?»

hi.L: इसलिए जब दाख की बारी का स्वामी आएगा, तो वह उन किसानों के साथ क्या करेगा?"
hi.B: अब जब दाख की बारी का मालिक आएगा, तो वह उन बटाईदारों के साथ क्या करेगा?"
hi.R: तो जब बाग़ का मालिक लौटकर आएगा, तो वह उन किसानों के साथ क्या करेगा?"

uk.L: Отже, коли прийде пан виноградника, що він зробить тим виноградарям?»
uk.B: Тож коли прийде господар виноградника, що він зробить тим виноградарям?»
uk.R: Що ж зробить господар виноградника з тими селянами, коли повернеться?»

ja.L: それでは、ぶどう園の主人が来るとき、彼はあの小作人たちに何をするだろうか？」
ja.B: では、ぶどう園の持ち主が来たら、あの小作人たちをどうするだろうか？」
ja.R: では、ぶどう園の持ち主が帰って来たら、その農夫たちをどうするだろう？」

decisions.choice: master: the owner of the vineyard
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the Lord, but in the story it means the owner. It hints at who the owner stands for.

decisions.choice: what will he do: Jesus lets the hearers pass judgment
decisions.reason: As in 21:28-31, the hearers give the verdict. They answer in 21:41.

decisions.choice: "주인" for kyrios
decisions.reason: In the story kyrios is the owner of the vineyard (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "пан" (L); "господар" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Masters in parables are "пан" at Literal, as in the rest of the Gospels; Balanced and Readable say "господар", the owner of the farm, as the English says "owner" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "主人" (L); "持ち主" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is owner or master, and also the word for Lord (m1). Literal says "主人", which keeps the link to "主"; Balanced and Readable use the plain word for an owner, as in Mark 12:9.

source.text: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Κακοὺς κακῶς ἀπολέσει αὐτούς, καὶ τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἐκδώσεται ἄλλοις γεωργοῖς, οἵτινες ἀποδώσουσιν αὐτῷ τοὺς καρποὺς ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς αὐτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: They say to him, Bad men badly he will destroy them, and the vineyard he will rent out to other farmers, who will give to him the fruits in the seasons of them.

en.L: They say to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "[Those] wretches he will destroy wretchedly, and he will lease the vineyard to other farmers, who will give him the fruits in their seasons."
en.B: They answered {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "He will put those evil men to a miserable death, and he will lease the vineyard to other tenants, who will hand over the fruit to him at each harvest."
en.R: They answered {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "He will kill those evil men in a terrible way. Then he will rent the vineyard to other farmers. They will give him his share of the grapes at harvest time."

es.L: Le dicen: «A [esos] malvados los destruirá malamente, y arrendará la viña a otros agricultores, que le entregarán los frutos en sus tiempos».
es.B: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondieron: «Hará morir de mala manera a esos malvados, y dará la viña en arriendo a otros que le entreguen el fruto en cada cosecha».
es.R: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondieron: «Matará a esos malvados de una manera terrible. Luego alquilará la viña a otros agricultores. Ellos le darán su parte de las uvas en el tiempo de la cosecha».

fr.L: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disent : « Ces misérables, il les fera périr misérablement, et il louera la vigne à d’autres vignerons, qui lui remettront les fruits en leur temps. »
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} répondirent : « Ces méchants, il les fera mourir d’une mort misérable, et il louera la vigne à d’autres vignerons, qui lui remettront le produit à chaque récolte. »
fr.R: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont répondu : « Il fera mourir ces hommes mauvais d’une manière terrible. Puis il louera la vigne à d’autres cultivateurs. Ils lui donneront sa part du raisin au moment de la récolte. »

sw.L: Wanamwambia, "Wale wabaya atawaangamiza vibaya, na shamba la mizabibu atawapa wakulima wengine kwa kukodi, ambao watampa matunda katika majira yake."
sw.B: Wakamjibu, "Atawaua watu hao waovu kwa kifo kibaya, na shamba la mizabibu atawakodishia wakulima wengine, watakaompa mavuno kila msimu wa mavuno."
sw.R: Wakamjibu, "Atawaua watu hao waovu kwa njia ya kutisha. Kisha atawakodishia wakulima wengine shamba hilo. Wao watampa sehemu yake ya zabibu wakati wa mavuno."

vi.L: Họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Ông sẽ tiêu diệt cách thảm hại những kẻ gian ác ấy, và cho các tá điền khác thuê vườn nho, là những người sẽ nộp hoa lợi cho ông đúng mùa."
vi.B: Họ trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Ông sẽ giết những kẻ gian ác đó cách thê thảm, rồi cho các tá điền khác thuê vườn nho, là những người sẽ nộp hoa lợi cho ông mỗi mùa thu hoạch."
vi.R: Họ trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Ông chủ sẽ giết những kẻ độc ác ấy một cách thật khủng khiếp. Rồi ông sẽ cho những người nông dân khác thuê vườn nho. Những người này sẽ nộp phần nho cho ông khi đến mùa hái nho."

ko.L: 그들이 그분께 말한다. "그 악한 자들을 비참하게 멸망시키고, 포도원은 제때에 소출을 바칠 다른 농부들에게 세를 줄 것입니다."
ko.B: 그들이 예수께 대답했다. "그 악한 자들을 비참하게 죽이고, 포도원은 철마다 소출을 바칠 다른 농부들에게 맡길 것입니다."
ko.R: 그들이 예수께 대답했다. "그 나쁜 사람들을 무섭게 벌하여 죽일 것입니다. 그리고 그 포도밭은 다른 농부들에게 빌려줄 것입니다. 그 농부들은 포도를 거둘 때마다 주인의 몫을 바칠 것입니다."

pt.L: Eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} dizem: "[Esses] miseráveis, ele os destruirá miseravelmente, e arrendará a vinha a outros agricultores, que lhe entregarão os frutos nos tempos deles."
pt.B: Eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} responderam: "Ele dará uma morte terrível a esses homens maus e arrendará a vinha a outros agricultores, que lhe entregarão os frutos a cada colheita."
pt.R: Eles responderam: "Ele vai matar esses homens maus de um jeito terrível. Depois vai alugar a vinha para outros agricultores. Eles vão dar ao dono a parte das uvas que é dele na época da colheita."

am.L: ይሉታል፦ «እነዚያን ክፉዎች ክፉኛ ያጠፋቸዋል፤ የወይን ቦታውንም በየወቅቱ ፍሬውን ለሚሰጡት ለሌሎች ገበሬዎች ያከራያል።»
am.B: እነርሱም «እነዚያን ክፉ ሰዎች በአሰቃቂ ሞት ያጠፋቸዋል፤ የወይን ቦታውንም በየመከሩ ጊዜ ፍሬውን ለሚያስረክቡት ለሌሎች ተከራዮች ያከራያል» ብለው መለሱለት።
am.R: እነርሱም እንዲህ ብለው መለሱለት፦ «እነዚያን ክፉ ሰዎች በአስከፊ ሁኔታ ይገድላቸዋል። ከዚያም የወይን ቦታውን ለሌሎች ገበሬዎች ያከራያል። እነርሱም በመከር ጊዜ ከወይኑ ድርሻውን ይሰጡታል።»

ru.L: Говорят {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Злодеев злой смертью погубит он их, и виноградник сдаст другим земледельцам, которые будут отдавать ему плоды в свои сроки.»
ru.B: Они ответили {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Этих злодеев он предаст злой смерти, а виноградник сдаст другим арендаторам, которые будут отдавать ему плоды в каждый урожай.»
ru.R: Они ответили {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Он жестоко убьёт этих злых людей. А виноградник он отдаст другим земледельцам. Они будут отдавать ему его часть урожая во время сбора.»

hi.L: वे उनसे कहते हैं, "वह उन बुरों का बुरी तरह नाश करेगा, और दाख की बारी दूसरे किसानों को ठेके पर देगा, जो अपने-अपने समय पर उसे फल देंगे।"
hi.B: उन्होंने यीशु को उत्तर दिया, "वह उन दुष्टों को बुरी मौत मारेगा, और दाख की बारी दूसरे बटाईदारों को ठेके पर दे देगा, जो हर फ़सल पर उसका हिस्सा उसे सौंप देंगे।"
hi.R: उन्होंने यीशु को जवाब दिया, "वह उन बुरे आदमियों को बहुत बुरी तरह मार डालेगा। फिर वह बाग़ दूसरे किसानों को किराये पर दे देगा। वे फ़सल के समय उसे अंगूरों में से उसका हिस्सा देंगे।"

uk.L: Кажуть {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «[Тих] лихих він лихо погубить, а виноградник віддасть іншим виноградарям, які віддаватимуть йому плоди в їхню пору.»
uk.B: Вони відповіли {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «Тих лиходіїв він покарає лютою смертю, а виноградник здасть в оренду іншим виноградарям, які віддаватимуть йому плоди, коли настане час збору.»
uk.R: Вони відповіли {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «Він жорстоко вбʼє тих злих людей. Потім він здасть виноградник в оренду іншим селянам. Вони віддаватимуть йому його частину врожаю, коли настане час збирати виноград.»

ja.L: 彼らはイエスに言う。「その悪人どもを悪人にふさわしく無残に滅ぼし、ぶどう園は、季節ごとに実を彼に納めるほかの小作人たちに貸すだろう。」
ja.B: 彼らはイエスに答えた。「その悪人どもをひどい目にあわせて殺し、ぶどう園は、収穫のたびに実を納めるほかの小作人たちに貸すだろう。」
ja.R: 彼らはイエスに答えました。「その悪い者たちを、ひどいやり方で殺すだろう。そして、ぶどう園をほかの農夫たちに貸すだろう。その農夫たちは、とり入れの時ごとに、持ち主にぶどうの分け前を渡すだろう。」

decisions.choice: bad men badly: a play on words, the evil end of evil men
decisions.reason: The adjective and the adverb come from the same word. The punishment matches the crime.

decisions.choice: the hearers pronounce their own sentence
decisions.reason: The chief priests and elders (21:23) give the verdict on the tenants before they see that the story is about them (21:45), as David did before Nathan (2 Samuel 12:5-7).

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: put those evil men to a miserable death (B); kill those evil men in a terrible way (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the link between the men and their end without the repeated word.

decisions.choice: malvados ... malamente (L); de mala manera a esos malvados (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on "bad" and "badly" (meaning decision m1). "Malvados" and "malamente" or "de mala manera" keep the echo in Spanish. The "le" at the start of the Literal sentence is written plain; it is Jesus.

decisions.choice: Ces misérables, il les fera périr misérablement (L)
alternatives: Ces méchants, il les fera périr méchamment
decisions.reason: French can keep the play on words (m1) with "misérables ... misérablement", which says both their wickedness and their wretched end; "méchamment" would mean that the owner acts with malice.

decisions.choice: wabaya ... vibaya (bad ones ... badly)
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on "bad" and "badly" (meaning decision m1). Swahili "wabaya" and "vibaya" share a stem, so Literal keeps the echo; Balanced and Readable say the sense plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "tiêu diệt cách thảm hại những kẻ gian ác" (L); "giết những kẻ gian ác ... cách thê thảm" (B); "giết những kẻ độc ác ... thật khủng khiếp" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on "bad" and "badly" (meaning decision); Vietnamese cannot repeat one word, so it pairs "gian ác" with "thảm", which carry the same weight. Literal keeps the present "say" without "đã".

decisions.choice: "악한 자들을 비참하게" (L, B); "나쁜 사람들을 무섭게" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on "bad... badly" (meaning decision); Korean cannot repeat the word naturally, so the sense is kept.

decisions.choice: The leaders answer in 합쇼체; present "말한다" (L)
decisions.reason: People speak to Jesus in 합쇼체; Literal keeps Matthew's present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: miseráveis ... miseravelmente
decisions.reason: Portuguese can keep the Greek play on one root (m1) with "miseráveis" and "miseravelmente", as the English Literal does with "wretches ... wretchedly"; "maus ... de modo mau" would not read as Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "ክፉዎችን ክፉኛ" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on one word, evil men evilly; "ክፉኛ" (badly, severely) comes from the same root as "ክፉ", so Amharic can keep the play at Literal. Balanced and Readable give the sense.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; "उनसे", "यीशु को" with the honorific
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for Jesus comes from the honorific plural at every level, as the style guide says, in this whole passage.

decisions.choice: "उन बुरों का बुरी तरह नाश"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek play on "bad" and "badly" (meaning decision m1), which Hindi can repeat with "बुरा"; Balanced and Readable keep the link in "दुष्टों को बुरी मौत" and "बुरे आदमियों को बहुत बुरी तरह".

decisions.choice: "злодеев ... злой смертью"
decisions.reason: Russian can keep the Greek play on "bad men badly" with words of the same root, so Literal and Balanced do; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "лихих ... лихо погубить"
decisions.reason: Ukrainian "лихий" and "лихо" keep the Greek play on the evil end of evil men (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable give the sense plainly.

decisions.choice: present "言う" (L); past "答えた", "答えました" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew tells this in the present tense; Literal keeps the Japanese present, Balanced and Readable narrate in the past, as in the rest of this passage (21:42).

decisions.choice: the leaders answer in the plain style; "悪人どもを悪人にふさわしく" (L)
alternatives: polite "でしょう" for the leaders
decisions.reason: The chief priests and elders (21:23) are rulers giving a verdict, not petitioners, so their answer is plain, not です・ます. Literal keeps the play on bad men and a bad end (m1) with "悪人……悪人にふさわしく"; Balanced and Readable say only that the end will be terrible.

source.text: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ἐν ταῖς γραφαῖς· Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας· παρὰ κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη, καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν;

records.literal_gloss: Says to them the Jesus, Never did you read in the Scriptures, A stone which rejected the building ones, this became into head of corner; from Lord came this, and it is marvelous in eyes of us?

en.L: Jesus says to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures, \q '[The] stone that the builders rejected, \q this has become [the] head of [the] corner; \q from [the] Lord this came about, \q and it is marvelous in our eyes'?
en.B: Jesus said to them, \q "Did you never read this in the Scriptures: \q 'The very stone the builders turned down has become the cornerstone. \q The Lord has brought this about, \q and we look on it with wonder'?
en.R: Jesus said to them, \q "Surely you have read this in the Scriptures: \q 'The stone that the builders did not want has become the most important stone in the building. \q The Lord did this, and it is wonderful to us.'

es.L: Jesús les dice: «¿Nunca {{plural_you:leyeron|leísteis}} en las Escrituras: \q “La piedra que rechazaron los constructores, \q esta ha llegado a ser cabeza de [la] esquina; \q de parte del Señor sucedió esto, \q y es admirable a nuestros ojos”?
es.B: Jesús les dijo: «¿Nunca {{plural_you:leyeron|leísteis}} esto en las Escrituras: \q “La misma piedra que los constructores descartaron ha llegado a ser la piedra angular. \q Esto lo ha hecho el Señor, \q y lo miramos con asombro”?
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Seguro que {{plural_you:han leído|habéis leído}} esto en las Escrituras: \q “La piedra que los constructores no quisieron ha llegado a ser la piedra más importante del edificio. \q El Señor hizo esto, y para nosotros es algo maravilloso”.

fr.L: Jésus leur dit : « N’avez-vous jamais lu dans les Écritures : \q “La pierre que ceux qui bâtissaient ont rejetée, \q celle-ci est devenue la tête de l’angle ; \q cela est venu du Seigneur, \q et c’est merveilleux à nos yeux” ?
fr.B: Jésus leur dit : « N’avez-vous jamais lu ce passage des Écritures : \q “La pierre même que les bâtisseurs ont écartée est devenue la pierre maîtresse de l’angle. \q C’est l’œuvre du Seigneur, \q et nous la regardons avec émerveillement” ?
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Vous avez sûrement lu ce que disent les Écritures : \q “Les bâtisseurs n’ont pas voulu d’une certaine pierre. \q Mais elle est devenue la pierre la plus importante de la construction. \q C’est le Seigneur qui a fait cela, et nous en sommes émerveillés.”

sw.L: Yesu anawaambia, "Je, hamjawahi kusoma katika Maandiko, \q 'Jiwe ambalo wajenzi walilikataa, \q hilo limefanyika kichwa cha pembe; \q jambo hili limefanyika na Bwana, \q nalo ni la kustaajabisha mbele ya macho yetu'?
sw.B: Yesu akawaambia, \q "Je, hamjawahi kusoma maneno haya katika Maandiko: \q 'Lile jiwe ambalo wajenzi walilikataa limekuwa jiwe la msingi la pembeni. \q Bwana ndiye aliyefanya jambo hili, \q nasi tunalitazama kwa mshangao'?
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, \q "Hakika mmesoma maneno haya katika Maandiko: \q 'Jiwe ambalo wajenzi hawakulitaka limekuwa jiwe muhimu kuliko yote katika jengo. \q Bwana amefanya jambo hili, nalo ni la ajabu kwetu.'

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Các người chưa bao giờ đọc trong Kinh Thánh sao: \q 'Hòn đá mà những người thợ xây đã loại bỏ, \q chính hòn đá ấy đã trở thành đầu góc nhà; \q điều này đến từ Chúa, \q và thật lạ lùng trước mắt chúng ta'?
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: \q "Các người chưa từng đọc lời này trong Kinh Thánh sao: \q 'Hòn đá bị thợ xây loại bỏ đã trở thành tảng đá góc nhà quan trọng nhất. \q Đó là việc Chúa làm, \q và chúng ta nhìn thấy mà kinh ngạc'?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Chắc chắn các người đã đọc lời này trong Kinh Thánh: \q 'Thợ xây không muốn dùng một hòn đá kia. \q Nhưng hòn đá ấy đã trở thành hòn đá quan trọng nhất của ngôi nhà. \q Chúa đã làm điều này, và chúng ta thấy thật lạ lùng.'

ko.L: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하신다. \q "너희는 성경에서 이 말씀을 한 번도 읽지 못하였느냐? \q '짓는 사람들이 버린 돌, 이 돌이 모퉁이의 머리가 되었다. \q 이 일은 주님께로부터 된 것이며, \q 우리 눈에 놀랍다.'
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. \q "너희는 성경에서 이 말씀을 읽어 보지 못했느냐? \q '집 짓는 사람들이 쓸모없다고 내버린 돌이 모퉁이를 받치는 으뜸 돌이 되었다. \q 이것은 주님께서 하신 일이니, \q 우리 눈에는 놀랍기만 하다.'
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 성경에 이렇게 쓰여 있는 것을 읽어 보았을 것이다. \q '집 짓는 사람들이 어떤 돌을 필요 없다고 버렸다. \q 그런데 그 돌이 건물에서 가장 중요한 돌이 되었다. \q 주님께서 이 일을 하셨다. \q 우리는 그것을 보고 놀란다.'

pt.L: Jesus lhes diz: "Vocês nunca leram nas Escrituras: \q '[A] pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, \q esta se tornou [a] cabeça da esquina; \q da parte [do] Senhor veio isto, \q e é coisa maravilhosa aos nossos olhos'?
pt.B: Jesus lhes disse: "Vocês nunca leram isto nas Escrituras: \q 'Justamente a pedra que os construtores recusaram se tornou a pedra angular. \q Foi o Senhor quem fez isso, \q e nós o contemplamos maravilhados'?
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: \q "Com certeza vocês já leram isto nas Escrituras: \q 'A pedra que os construtores não quiseram se tornou a pedra mais importante do prédio. \q O Senhor fez isso, e é uma coisa maravilhosa para nós.'

am.L: ኢየሱስ ይላቸዋል፦ «በመጻሕፍት \q “ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ፤ \q ይህ ከጌታ ዘንድ ሆነ፤ \q በዓይኖቻችንም ድንቅ ነው” የሚለውን ከቶ አላነበባችሁምን?
am.B: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «በመጻሕፍት ውስጥ \q “ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ የማዕዘን ራስ ድንጋይ ሆነ። \q ይህን ያደረገው ጌታ ነው፤ \q ለእኛም ድንቅ ሆኖ ይታየናል” የሚለውን ከቶ አላነበባችሁምን?
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ «በመጻሕፍት ውስጥ \q “ግንበኞች ያልፈለጉት ድንጋይ በሕንጻው ውስጥ ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ አስፈላጊ ድንጋይ ሆነ። \q ይህን ያደረገው ጌታ ነው፤ \q ለእኛም ድንቅ ነው” የሚለውን በእርግጥ አንብባችኋል።

ru.L: Говорит им Иисус: «Никогда не читали вы в Писаниях: \q “Камень, который отвергли строящие, \q этот стал главою угла; \q от Господа было это, \q и оно дивно в глазах наших”?
ru.B: Иисус сказал им: «Разве вы никогда не читали в Писании: \q “Тот самый камень, который отвергли строители, \q стал краеугольным камнем. \q Это сделал Господь, \q и мы смотрим на это с изумлением”?
ru.R: Иисус сказал им: «Вы ведь читали в Писании: \q “Камень, который строители не захотели взять, стал самым главным камнем в здании. \q Это сделал Господь, и это для нас чудесно.”

hi.L: यीशु उनसे कहते हैं, "क्या तुमने पवित्रशास्त्र में कभी नहीं पढ़ा, \q 'जिस पत्थर को बनानेवालों ने ठुकरा दिया, \q वह कोने का मुख्य [पत्थर] बन गया; \q यह प्रभु की ओर से हुआ, \q और यह हमारी आँखों में अचरज की बात है'?
hi.B: यीशु ने उनसे कहा, "क्या तुमने पवित्रशास्त्र में यह कभी नहीं पढ़ा: \q 'जिस पत्थर को राजमिस्त्रियों ने ठुकरा दिया, \q वही कोने का मुख्य पत्थर बन गया है। \q यह प्रभु ने किया है, \q और हम इसे देखकर अचंभा करते हैं'?
hi.R: यीशु ने उनसे कहा, \q "तुमने पवित्रशास्त्र में यह ज़रूर पढ़ा होगा: \q 'जिस पत्थर को बनानेवालों ने नहीं चाहा, वही इमारत का सबसे ज़रूरी पत्थर बन गया है। \q यह प्रभु ने किया है, और यह हमें अद्भुत लगता है।'

uk.L: Каже їм Ісус: «Хіба ви ніколи не читали в Писаннях: \q “Камінь, який відкинули ті, що будують, \q цей став головою кута; \q від Господа сталося це, \q і воно дивовижне в очах наших”?
uk.B: Ісус сказав їм: «Хіба ви ніколи не читали в Писаннях: \q “Камінь, який будівничі відкинули як непридатний, \q став наріжним каменем. \q Це вчинив Господь, \q і ми дивимося на це з подивом”?
uk.R: Ісус сказав їм: \q «Ви ж, напевно, читали в Писаннях: \q “Камінь, якого будівничі не захотіли взяти, став найголовнішим каменем у будівлі. \q Це зробив Господь, і нас це дивує.”

ja.L: イエスは彼らに言われる。「あなたがたは聖書の中で一度も読まなかったのか？ \q 『建てる者たちが退けた石、 \q これが隅の頭となった。 \q これは主から起こったことで、 \q わたしたちの目に驚くべきことである。』
ja.B: イエスは彼らに言われた。「あなたがたは、聖書のこの言葉を読んだことがないのか？ \q 『建てる者たちが役に立たないと捨てた石、 \q それが隅をつなぐ要の石となった。 \q 主がこれを起こされたのであり、 \q わたしたちはそれを見て驚嘆する。』
ja.R: イエスは彼らに言われました。 \q 「あなたたちは、聖書にこう書いてあるのを読んだはずだ。 \q 『家を建てる人たちは、ある石をいらないと言って捨てた。 \q けれども、その石が、建物でいちばん大切な石になった。 \q これは主がなさったことで、わたしたちは驚くばかりだ。』

decisions.reason: The words come from the same psalm the crowds sang in 21:9. Where Matthew has "Lord", the Hebrew has God's name, the LORD.

decisions.choice: the rejected stone: Jesus, rejected by the leaders and made chief by God
decisions.reason: The builders are the leaders who reject the son, as in the parable. Peter applies the verse to Jesus' death and resurrection (Acts 4:11; 1 Peter 2:7).

decisions.choice: head of the corner: the main stone that holds the corner
alternatives: the top stone over an arch
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean a cornerstone at the base or a capstone at the top. Either way it is the stone the whole building depends on.

decisions.choice: this came from the Lord: God has done it
alternatives: the stone came from the Lord
decisions.reason: "This" refers to the whole turn of events, the rejected stone becoming the chief one.

decisions.choice: present tense of narration (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek present tense of narration.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
decisions.reason: The question expects yes; Readable states it, as in 21:16.

decisions.choice: "đầu góc nhà" (L); "tảng đá góc nhà quan trọng nhất" (B); "hòn đá quan trọng nhất của ngôi nhà" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the parallel, Mark 12:10: Literal keeps the Greek picture, the head of the corner; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "Chúa", not the divine-name setting
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:11: the Greek has kyrios, so Vietnamese writes "Chúa" as the English writes "Lord"; the Hebrew of Psalm 118:23 has the divine name.

decisions.choice: The wording of the Korean Mark 12:10-11 for Psalm 118:22-23; "주님" with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: The same quotation reads alike in both Gospels; the Greek has kyrios, so the Korean says "주님" as in the Korean Mark.

decisions.choice: Present "말씀하신다" (L); past (B, R)
decisions.reason: Matthew's present tense of narration at Literal.

decisions.choice: a cabeça da esquina (L); a pedra angular (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture word for word; Balanced uses "pedra angular", the Portuguese name for the stone that holds a corner (m3). Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the quoted psalm placed before "የሚለውን ... አላነበባችሁምን?"
decisions.reason: Amharic puts the verb of reading last, so the psalm comes first and is tied to the question by "የሚለውን", as at 21:16.

decisions.choice: "የማዕዘን ራስ" (head of the corner)

decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the nations, but here it names a new people that does God's will (m1); French "une nation" would suggest a country, so every level says "un peuple", as the English does.

decisions.choice: watu (a people)
decisions.reason: The word can mean a nation, but here it is a people that does God's will (meaning decision m1), not another country. "Taifa" would suggest a state; "watu" says a people.

decisions.choice: "một dân" (L, B), "những người" (R); "hoa lợi" for its fruits at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "a people" as a new community that does God's will, not one nation, which "dân tộc" would suggest; "hoa lợi" is the word of the parable (21:34, 21:41), so the saying is heard as its key.

decisions.choice: God as the one who takes and gives (L, R: "빼앗아... 주실 것이다"); passives at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Greek passives mean that God acts; Korean passives of these verbs are heavy, so Literal and Readable use the active with the honorific for God, and Balanced keeps the passive form.

decisions.choice: "민족" (L); "백성" (B, R) for ethnos
